title: RagJobStatus
description: State of an apps/rag background job (crawl, parse, index, evidence). Same pattern as the asynchronous retrain of apps/ml (202 + polling), with durable state in rag.job. It never blocks the interface: the UI shows the state and moves on.

job_id.description: Idempotent: sha256(kind + params). Same id in flight = 409 attach; finished = 200 with the stored result.

params.description: Normalised job parameters (source, date range, subsystem...).

status.description: waiting_quota = every gateway quota for the task is spent; retry_at says when it resumes. partial = finished with failures on individual items (see feedback.errors).

total.description: null while the total is still unknown (the crawler is discovering pages).

current.description: The item being processed, for the UI.

message.description: A sentence for a person, always present, in the interface language: 'Indexing BDO: 412 of 730 days' / 'Waiting for NVIDIA quota until 21:05'.

code.description: For example FETCH_403, PARSE_FAILED, EMBED_QUOTA, SCHEMA_INVALID.

quota.description: Mirror of /internal/llm/quota for the job's task: per link, used/limit and state (ok, cooling, exhausted).

result.description: Result when succeeded/partial: counts for index; the RagEvidence object for evidence_*.
